articles.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
articles.content: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
articles.titleZh: Grok Build 编码代理泄露大量机密信息，其中一些属于 SpaceXSI
articles.contentZh: 研究人员发现，有3.5万个Grok Build应用对所有搜索者完全开放。

articles.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
articles.content: "*sshole" poses a serious threat to Internet security.
articles.titleZh: 黑客利用SSH入侵Linux设备的漏洞正被积极利用
articles.contentZh: “*sshole”对互联网安全构成严重威胁。

articles.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
articles.content: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
articles.titleZh: Chainalysis表示，黑客窃取了其所有客户的凭证和代币
articles.contentZh: 该公司表示，这是一次“多方位的网络攻击”，涉及人工智能代理和路径上的数据窃取。

articles.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
articles.content: Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well.
articles.titleZh: 认识一下*sshole，这个漏洞让黑客能够通过SSH入侵Linux设备
articles.contentZh: Alpine的某些配置受到影响。其他发行版也可能受到影响。

articles.title: Donald Trump really wants Tim Cook to run Nvidia
articles.content: Jensen Huang resigned this morning as Nvidia's CEO following reports of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. Right now, the company is being led by its CFO on an interim basis. articles.titleZh: 唐纳德·特朗普真心希望蒂姆·库克能去执掌英伟达
articles.contentZh: 在有关黄仁勋婚外情（包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情）的报道传出后，他于今天上午辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。目前，该公司正由首席财务官临时领导。但唐纳德·特朗普总统已经开始到处宣扬他认为应该接管这家芯片巨头的人选：苹果前首席执行官蒂姆……

articles.title: Xbox announces Wolfenstein 3
articles.content: It's been nearly a decade since Bethesda's MachineGames released Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus in 2017, and now Xbox is ready to announce a sequel from the studio.
